paragraphs: Menashi of Biri of Naresh. His son Rav Giddel — Yoma 81b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied body has מבירי, while the catalog label has מכירי. Yoma 81b in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic has מִבֵּירֵי דְנַרֶשׁ, supporting the place construction “from Beirei of Naresh,” rather than “who was expounded.” The source’s Menashi form is retained.
Hyman explicitly calls Rav Giddel his son; Rav is written in full. Yoma 81b follows פא: under the colon convention and contains the corresponding bar relationship.
